defs.def: a piece of clothing that covers the body from the waist down and is divided into two parts to cover each leg separately 裤子adj.

ex.s: I only used to have five identical pairs of trousers and five identical shirts.
ex.t: 我以前只有五条一样的裤子和五条一样的衬衫

ex.s: Martin: Er… Not really … Hey, wait, do you mean trousers—what you and I are wearing on our legs right now?
Usually, Chaplin appeared in these films as the Little Tramp, a poor man with a moustache, large trousers, worn-out shoes, and a small, round hat.
ex.t: 通常卓别林在这些电影中以"小特兰普"(The Little Tramp)的身份出现,他是一个有胡子,长大裤子,磨损的鞋子,以及小圆形帽子的穷人.

ex.s: He becomes so desperate in the end that he even hides some inside the purse of a woman sitting near him and throws some down the trousers of the restaurant's violinist!
ex.t: 他最后变得如此绝望,甚至把一些藏在坐在他身边的一个女人的钱包里,然后扔下餐厅小提琴手的裤子!
